source_caption:
🎬 Employee of the Month (2006)

Employee of the Month follows Zack Bradley, a laid-back employee working at a large warehouse retail store who has little interest in advancing his career. His attitude changes when Amy, an attractive new cashier, joins the store and Zack discovers that she supposedly has a preference for employees who earn the prestigious Employee of the Month award. Determined to impress her, Zack begins competing against Vince Downey, an ambitious and arrogant cashier who has dominated the competition for months. As their rivalry intensifies, the workplace becomes filled with hilarious schemes, unexpected challenges, and outrageous confrontations. Along the way, Zack begins discovering the importance of ambition, responsibility, and genuine relationships. Starring Dane Cook, Jessica Simpson, and Dax Shepard, the film delivers entertaining workplace comedy and lighthearted romance while exploring competition, friendship, personal growth, and the consequences of trying too hard to impress someone.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 5.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 48m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Greg Coolidge

source_details.title: Employee of the Month
source_details.synopsis: Employee of the Month is a 2006 American comedy film directed by Greg Coolidge, who co-wrote it with Don Calame and Chris Conroy, and starring Dane Cook, Jessica Simpson, and Dax Shepard. The film's plot revolves around two warehouse club employees who compete for the affection of their newest co-worker. The film was shot primarily at the Costco store in Albuquerque, New Mexico, (warehouse #116). The film was released by Lionsgate Films on October 6, 2006, and grossed $38.4 million against a $10–12 million budget despite negative reviews from critics.
